title: credit.forfeited payload v1
description: A hold forfeited (no-show, late cancel). held is the units the lock held, for an expired lock whose mutation does not say.

slice.description: Positions in mutation.changes that this event is made from, when one mutation is booked as several events (one per feature and plan). Absent: all of them. The mutation is always the whole one.

complete.description: Written by a handler that logs every engine command it runs (after atm 0.3.0), so a revision with no event in the log was a write of the grants row alone. Absent on what 0.3.0 wrote, which did not log some commands.
